cover.report_type: Interim Report: October 28 (seven days before a general election)

contributions.detail: exact (117447.70 = $117,447.70). 266 attachment rows sum to the penny to the attachment's own printed 'Total Contributions $117,447.70', which equals the Summary Page stated figure. Any single misread digit or dropped/duplicated row would break this, so the sum doubles as a full-side verification

expenditures.detail: exact (147884.20 = $147,884.20). 41 attachment rows sum to the penny to the printed 'Total Expenses - Period Ending 10/27/14 $147,884.20', which equals the Summary Page stated figure

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NEITHER Schedule A nor Schedule B form page prints a subtotal - both say 'See Attached' and their SUBTOTAL/TOTAL boxes are EMPTY, so there is no per-page subtotal to gate on. The attachments carry ONE grand total each (contributions p9, expenditures p11) and BOTH gate exactly against the transcribed rows and against the Summary Page. Per-attachment-page subtotals do not exist in this document
itemized.escalation_note: the attachments are machine-printed spreadsheets, legible at 200dpi; no cell required escalation. Verification was by full-side arithmetic against the printed grand totals (both exact)
itemized.notes: Sim Gill, District Attorney, October 28 2014 interim (7 days before the general) - the largest filing in this chunk. STRUCTURE: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3 Schedule A form page reading only 'See Attached' with empty subtotal/total boxes, p4-p9 the contributions spreadsheet ('Contributions Period Ending 10/27/14', 266 rows, LANDSCAPE - rotated 90 degrees clockwise from the portrait render), p10 Schedule B form page reading 'See Attached' with empty boxes, p11 the expenditures spreadsheet ('Expenditures for Period Ending 10/27/14', 41 rows, PORTRAIT). GEOMETRY: the contribution rows sit on landscape pages; their pct: rectangles are converted BACK to the portrait orientation poppler renders, so each row is a narrow VERTICAL strip (x = the row's position, h spans the page) - that is correct, not a bug. Row bands were measured by detecting the table rules, pitch 29.6px at 200dpi. REDACTION: on attachment pages 4-8 the Address column is covered by the county's black bar, but the separate City / State / Zip columns are NOT covered and were read; attachment page 9 is NOT redacted at all and prints full street addresses - those were discarded at read time and never written anywhere (privacy rule), only city/state retained. The spreadsheet's trailing column carries 'In Kind' on 9 contribution rows and 9 expenditure rows. Contribution row 'Miscellaneous Cash Contributions' ($70.00, 10/23/14) has no name, city or state - an aggregate line, kept verbatim. Two filers put employer/occupation in swapped columns (Partridge, Beseiso) - not a transcribed field here, noted only. In-kind items appear on both sides where the filer recorded them so (Lisa Ashman, Phil McCarthey, JT Martin, Martine Cafe, the four 10/23 fundraiser hosts).
